description: Count word frequencies in a text using only the standard string toolkit: split on whitespace, strip the four marks .,!? from each token's ends, lowercase it, skip tokens that become empty, and tally the rest into a dict. Pure and deterministic; no external dependency is required to do this. The golden arg_sets cover the value-returning domain including the decisive edges (the empty string and a whitespace-only string both yield {}, a punctuation-only string yields {}, mixed case folds to one key, and only leading/trailing .,!? are stripped while interior and other punctuation stay part of the word).
